releases.name: Starship Crafter
releases.summary:
Take on the starship mechanic role and pay the immense debt your father left you with. 

Upgrade your workshop, craft components, build starships, do contracts for factions, follow the ongoing events with the daily newspaper, and most importantly, pay the debt before the deadline.

releases.name: Monster Showdown
releases.summary: You play as a Reaper who was sent out to hunt down monsters who have invaded the land. Visit haunted locations filled with all sorts of strange beings. No run will be the same due to procedurally generated levels and a multitude of ability upgrades.

releases.name: Kings of Oros
releases.summary: In Oros, battles are real physical interactions, not static animations. Swings carry momentum, collisions have weight. Find synergies in weapons, relics, cards, enchantments, classes and more to unleash crazy builds and try to break the game as you battle armies, bosses, and other players in PVP.

releases.name: DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE
releases.summary: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from Commodore 64.  The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

releases.name: Meow Star Archives
releases.summary: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats’ severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. As you restore the archives, you’ll uncover the heartfelt stories of these lovely kitties before they journey back to the stars.

releases.name: Carry On Together
releases.summary: Carry On Together is an online co-op moving game for up to 4 players, where you build a small delivery company with your friends and every job can turn into chaos. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?

releases.name: Survivors
releases.summary: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.

releases.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
releases.summary: Introducing "Word Puzzle for the Mother's Soul", This is a beautiful inspirational motherly quotes inspired Word Game.• 87 inspirational levels• Intuitive Controls• Animated Tutorial• Hours of Inspiration Challenging Fun Game Play!• Internalize/Absorb quotes better by challenged enigmatic Game Play!.On the game board, you are given a quote by great men and women. The tiles are shuffled and not readable. Your task is to put the tiles back into their places and recover the original quote.To reconstruct a quote, you must swap the letter tiles until you get every correct words. The tiles can only be swapped vertically in its respective column.Once the original quote is revealed you level up!. Be inspired by these great quotes from great minds.

releases.name: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
releases.summary: A UE5 open-world comedy game. Play as a super-rich kid who is accidentally transported from a modern city to a medieval world. Explore both eras, complete quests, interact with NPCs, drive around, start fights, and enjoy a free and absurd time-travel adventure.c

releases.name: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
releases.summary: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a reel SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

releases.name: The House on Grisewood
releases.summary: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival mode.

releases.name: Dusky's Nook
releases.summary: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

releases.name: Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower
releases.summary: Discover an abandoned alchemy tower in the forest and reorganize it at your own pace to become its new owner. Arrange more than 2,500 randomly scattered objects using a map and ancient magical runes, unlock blocked rooms, and enjoy an experience with no time limits.

releases.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
releases.summary: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

releases.name: Tidy Mall Together
releases.summary: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 4,600 runaway things back onto the shelves of 11 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

releases.name: How Smart Are You
releases.summary: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

releases.name: Embodybird
releases.summary: Embodybird is a small, physics-based game with continuous bird flight controls. Decide how hard to flap, how far to spread your wings—even how wide to fan your feathers! Fly, land, hunt, and carry your catch home before dark. EMBODY THE BIRD!

releases.name: Construction Site: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.

releases.name: 2D Hates 3D
releases.summary: A short incremental game where you play as Commander, leading a squad of flat 2D shapes against an invasion of 3D ones. Clear timed waves, collect scrap. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from squad damage to time-bending perks. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

releases.name: Dear Gardener
releases.summary: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals.

releases.name: Sort My Pigs
releases.summary: Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn hearts, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, no motion sickness, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

releases.name: For Our King
releases.summary: A medieval Tower Defense x Autobattler Roguelite. Defend your Keep across escalating waves, recruit different unit types, and cast spells from different Schools of Magic. Spend what you earn on a skill tree with over 300 upgrades, and place them on a Decree Bar with many unique modifiers and mults.

releases.name: Creator Tycoon
releases.summary: Run a creator company with your own studio and production team. Combine production cards, design workflows, and furnish your workspace with equipment and housing items in this management sim. Develop your staff, grow channels, and expand through sponsorships and creator contracts.

releases.name: Komorebi Alchemy
releases.summary: Gather materials, practice alchemy, and grow a little shop with your companions in this shopkeeping RPG. Enjoy puzzle-based crafting, workshop decorating, a café, farming, and town development as you prepare for raids. Your creations can help protect the town.

releases.name: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME
releases.summary:
Did you know that Moscow attracts mysterious magical creatures at night? Going towards the northern lights, they interfere with the city lights and are attracted to the depths of the modern metropolis.

During the day you are a designer: work, communicate with friends, and at night go to the rooftops of Moscow and accompany magical creatures.

A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

releases.name: Lost Camp
releases.summary: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

releases.name: The Endless Harvest
releases.summary: Ever been to Thailand? Bangkok Betty is a new twist on an old Beer Pong favourite. Help Betty to launch her Ping Pong Balls off of the obstacles and into the Pint Glass, and remember to collect as many coins as you can while you're at it.Bangkok Betty is a fun physics and puzzle game with great re-playability.Stay tuned for more worlds in free app updates, coming very soon!

releases.name: Mapping Creator
releases.summary: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!
